factorRatings.note: My Ballard's 2019 opening coverage describes a by-the-slice NY-style pizza bar built into the Polimenakos family's longtime Ballard diner space, serving big slices and 18-inch pies until 1am alongside a full bar, pinball and karaoke; the restaurant's own menu (slices $5.75-8, 14"/18" pies $22-39, red and white pies with build-your-own options) confirms a casual, late-night pizza-bar niche, though coverage doesn't go deep on the pizza's craft itself.
